text: I'm a childminder with a 7 month old girl overnight. Temp is 39.6. Her breathing is really fast. When I lift her vest I can see the skin sucking in under her ribs every breath, and she's making a little grunt noise at the end of each one. She also keeps stopping for a second or two before she starts again. She won't settle off to sleep tonight but apart from that she's been her usual self. No rash anywhere on her, I've checked all over. Parents are on their way but I wanted advice now.
